attempts.scope: All three memories recovered; reached Custodian and disabled coil 1. No upload or victory seen.
narrative: Deployed fresh at 00:00. Fired initial centered rifle burst, killed induction guard, shield 41; reloaded and advanced northwest.
Recovered Mara at 00:23 after strafing into west archive and holding E. Fired at visible sentinel afterward without elimination; turned and consulted paused facility map.
Moved east then north toward Heart. Hold at 00:35 failed at 15m. Turn/move/hold at 00:41 also failed: blocked by low cover, health fell to 46.
Flanked with D and Shift, moved forward, held E at 7m at 00:48: still too far. Corrected left 1.2s; E hold succeeded for Sera at 00:53 while rifle fire emptied magazine into poor aim/no elimination.
Reloaded and moved diagonally southeast with Shift, reached Elian; held E while firing, recovered Elian at 01:01.
Attempted relative turn x2500: driver rejected Invalid relative mouse delta. Corrected to two x1250 looks; moved toward Custodian with health 49 at 01:06.
Strafed then moved into wall at 01:11, corrected around ground route at 01:18. Fired at coil 1 and disabled it by 01:21, health 13. Reloaded, Shift and aimed toward next coil; died at 01:26.

Advanced north then strafed right to 3m; attempted turn after movement yielded confusing heading/view. Backed away and aimed, spent 29 shots with all coils 100%.

Turned back toward visible front coils at 01:54 and disabled coil 1. Reloaded and adjusted aim; at 01:59 coil 1 OFF, coil 3 OFF, coil 2 15%, health 63.
Reloaded and made small aim correction while remaining exposed; final firing batch ended in death at cumulative 02:04.

attempts.narrative: Killed induction guard by optic fire. Went west using map, collided with central cover (5.5 seconds W gained only 6m), moved left then forward. First E hold failed outside reach at 3.1m; moved right and recovered Mara. Two aimed patrol bursts and correction/reload mostly missed while stationary, shield fell to zero and health 46. Dash/right strafe plus more missed fire left 14 health. Ran/dashed toward Heart; right strafe worsened distance and E hold failed at 8m. Back-left correction recovered Sera and health rose to 34. Phase break canceled a warden shot, but burst aimed to its right missed. Reload/optic correction finally registered second elimination as incoming damage killed me.

attempts.narrative: Short optic burst killed induction guard; chose east approach to explore. Machinery/cover stopped diagonal movement. D then W failed, repeated D/W failed, Space vault advanced a few metres but machinery stopped W again. Another D/W detour failed. Backtracking south/left moved partly but still reached machinery. Longer south/left finally returned to yard; sprint W was blocked by pillar, left detour succeeded. Approached Heart instead of west objective. E hold failed 0.6m outside reach. Small forward correction plus dash overshot to 5.4m; held E failed and stationary fire struck wall as warden was offscreen. Backward correction/hold failed, attempted switch to breacher and turn/fire; died with no memories. All misses and failed movement remain in raw actions.

gameplay.reason: Readable recover-three/jammer loop, useful recovery resupply, distinct guarded coils and checkpoint retry give a workable combat mission. My repeated poor exposed shooting was punished; phase and cover options existed. Navigation collisions and uncertain small coil hit regions made combat less fluid. Two deaths, no completed extraction; judgment limited to this slice.

presentation.reason: Strong teal/amber rainy station identity, polished title/death typography, reflected light and large Heart landmark. Blocky repeated robots, spare architecture and simple gun/hand geometry remain conspicuous. Software WebGL capture scope only; audio not assessed.

usability.reason: Visible controls, receiver prompts, distance labels, paused map and clearly labeled checkpoint continuation help. Failed holds correctly explain approach receiver. Low-cover blocking required trial-and-error, and combat hints compete for attention. Driver input/automatic pause adds friction outside normal human controls.

readability.reason: Large objective, health/ammo and coil percentages were useful; amber threats contrast with teal objectives. Tiny widely spaced labels, crowded top-center boss box and announcements overlapping it, obscured component geometry and small map icons reduce immediate comprehension. Inert housing feedback was useful but arrived after wasted bursts.

AAA readiness.reason: Cohesive playable vertical slice with functional terminal states and retry disclosure, but observed geometric simplicity, limited enemy visual detail, repeated set dressing, combat clarity friction and lack of demonstrated complete mission polish leave substantial distance to AAA release quality. Not a certification; two attempts cannot establish broad stability or performance.

Gameplay.reason: Receiver choice, optic weakpoints and phase-break mechanic offer decisions; recovering supplies made partial success rewarding. Most combat here became stationary misses and incoming damage. Two deaths and no full objective loop limit assessment; poor aim is mine, not proof of hit detection failure.

Presentation.reason: Cohesive cyan/amber rain-soaked station, striking relay centerpiece and polished menu/end typography. Blocky repeating enemies, flat bright monitor faces and broad simple architecture remain visibly prototype quality.

Usability.reason: Map pauses safely; controls, target distance and explicit outside-reach prompts help. I repeatedly failed receiver positioning and spent much of run two colliding with machinery despite apparently open side paths. Dash is easy to overshoot; synthetic paused controls add friction.

Readability.reason: Large health/ammo, cyan objectives and amber optics are legible. Small monospaced labels and tiny minimap need scrutiny; interaction/route notices occupy center while threats can remain offscreen. Surface appearance did not reliably communicate collision extent in my east detour.

AAA readiness.reason: A coherent playable prototype slice, but observed geometry, enemy models, combat animation and encounter navigation lack AAA finish. Neither run reached the ending systems, and software fallback plus paused automation cannot establish release performance, audio or production completeness.
